counter_paths_source: read from research/hermes/trader_v1/run_state/statistics.json (actual schema; no invented fields)

run_identity.run_end_utc: ISO8601 UTC or null until close
run_identity.source_hash: sha256 of the source snapshot used, immutable

run_manifest.manifest_hash: sha256 over all fields except manifest_hash

opening_accounting_boundary.forbidden: deriving opening state from the previous run's closing PnL

counter_schema.rule: ACCOUNT_LIFETIME counters must never be zeroed into run statistics

pnl_boundary.binding_rule: explicit run_id on every PnL event; no inference from co-location

broker_baseline.deal_mapping: broker_deal_id -> exactly one run; same deal must never map to >1 run
broker_baseline.recommended_policy: block a new run while the previous run has any open position

ledger_boundary.closed_run_rule: no ordinary events may be appended after RUN_CLOSE

new_run_open_event.note: previous_run_id is lineage only; it does not imply PnL inheritance

statistics_layout.forbidden: a single fixed statistics.json shared by all runs

requirements: RUN_A events intersect RUN_B events = empty
RUN_A PnL intersect RUN_B PnL = empty
cross_run_isolation.exception: account-lifetime state must be tagged ACCOUNT_SCOPE, not RUN_SCOPE

reset_not_delete.model: CLOSE OLD RUN -> FREEZE OLD RUN -> CREATE NEW RUN

automation_boundary.authority: a deterministic Run Manager performs the accounting operations

git_boundary.forbidden: git history as the only ledger storage

v1_compatibility.decoupling: run accounting is a separate layer

v1_compatibility_check.note: the design adds a Run Manager layer + per-run namespace; it does not alter entry/exit/risk/order logic or strategy parameters

CASE_01.requirement: new run must not inherit it

CASE_02.requirement: new run must have explicit initial state

CASE_03.scenario: old run has an open position

CASE_04.requirement: no ordinary event may be appended

CASE_05.scenario: two runs share one broker deal

acceptance_criteria_answers.1_what_is_a_run: an accounting epoch with immutable identity, own namespace, own counters, own PnL, own ledger
acceptance_criteria_answers.2_how_created: Run Manager writes runs/<run_id>/manifest.json + RUN_OPEN event after preconditions pass
acceptance_criteria_answers.3_how_closed: RUN_CLOSE event with final snapshots + hashes; status becomes CLOSED
acceptance_criteria_answers.4_how_frozen: append-only ledger + write-once manifest fields + RUN_CLOSE_HASH
acceptance_criteria_answers.6_counter_ownership: explicit run_scope in counter_schema; ACCOUNT_SCOPED never zeroed
acceptance_criteria_answers.7_pnl_ownership: explicit run_id on every PnL event; no inference
acceptance_criteria_answers.8_balance_recorded: opening/closing balance and equity in manifest; balance_delta separate from realized_pnl
acceptance_criteria_answers.10_ledger_binding: every record carries run_id + hash chain
acceptance_criteria_answers.11_run_isolation: per-run namespace + separate counters/PnL/ledger + ACCOUNT_SCOPE tagging
acceptance_criteria_answers.12_replay: load opening snapshot -> replay events -> reconstruct counters/PnL -> compare closing snapshot
acceptance_criteria_answers.14_automation_constraint: START_RUN/RUN_V1/CLOSE_RUN only; accounting done by Run Manager
acceptance_criteria_answers.15_v1_logic_unchanged: Run Boundary is a separate layer; entry/exit/risk/order/parameters untouched
